name: teaminternational.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 16 internal links lead to an error.
lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.
summary: www.teaminternational.com scores 64 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: 16 internal links lead to an error.

fix.title: 16 internal links lead to an error
fix.evidence: /en/careers answered The page is larger than the review limit., linked from /en, /en/solutions and 4 more. /en/case-studies/telenor answered 404, linked from /en/industries/telecom-it-solutions, /en/industries/healthcare-it-solutions and 4 more.…
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: 194 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links carry email addresses in the URL
fix.evidence: 1 link on /en/privacy-policy put an email address in the query string. Analytics tools record full URLs, and Google's terms forbid sending personal data.
fix.fix: Move the email out of the URL (POST it, or use an opaque token).

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /en/blog. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The sitemap lists 4 pages search engines should not index
fix.evidence: /en/careers (The page is larger than the review limit.), /en/case-studies/telenor (Status 404), /en/case-studies/texas-center (Status 404), /en/case-studies/allica-bank (Status 404).
fix.fix: List only live, canonical, indexable URLs in the sitemap.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
